title: Kanban column
summary: One column of a pk-kanban: a title with a card count, the cards, and a message when it has none. Place it directly inside a pk-kanban.

props.name: value
props.description: The identifier pk-kanban reports for this column in a pk-move event's from and to.

props.name: label
props.description: The column's title, and its accessible name. Falls back to value.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown in place of the cards while the column has none; it is also the drop target for a card dragged in.

props.name: dropTarget
props.description: Set by the surrounding pk-kanban while a dragged card is over this column.

parts.name: list
parts.description: The scrolling region that holds the cards; a long column scrolls here, not the page.

cssProperties.name: --pk-kanban-column-max-height
cssProperties.description: Height at which a long column starts to scroll.

a11y: role=list, named by label (or value); its cards are listitems. The count is text beside the title.
